vocabulary_gaps: VBAT is a charge output that shares the cell terminal with the battery's own output. UHD power roles are input/output/ground only; a board net joining the cell (PowerOut) and VBAT (PowerOut) will be reported by the net rule as two drivers. Modelled as power output with capability battery_charge, as on microchip-mcp73831t-2aci-ot; a charge-port role (or a battery charge-input interface) is needed.
